message: Imported canonical English Task 1 fixture Context 'participant/construction-updates/facility-updates' into profile 'task-1'.

99c29cea-9270-5a77-952c-b3f48da55612.content: The Main Building undergoes major facility improvement construction during summer break.

26131bc5-ee41-5d66-9507-4f11f9d0afde.content: During the construction period, the elevators operate alternately, one at a time.

5e34a7f5-41ab-5322-849b-f8304a1a3148.content: The visitor services desk suspends in-person operations during the construction period.

f460b6d0-66c8-581c-860f-a925cc03770e.content: During the construction period, visitor services are replaced by the visitor menu in the integrated campus portal.

cd0830c7-5289-529f-bedd-b0fd27d29b3f.content: The general restroom on the first floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

d73ccf7b-55d0-5f1c-8197-d3c9551da84d.content: The general restroom on the second floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

b9dda61f-7f10-5fad-ab6e-82ba3e7f8cf6.content: The general restroom on the third floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

7a58eb23-f1a1-552b-b4b1-c3732cbeeb86.content: Because the general restrooms on the first through third floors of the Main Building are closed during the construction period, the nearest general restroom changes to the exhibition hall on the third floor of the West Complex.

cb4f2f04-25c6-58ed-acd6-71b0a9c29b69.content: During the construction period, direct students, staff, and members who cannot use the Main Building restrooms to the Central Library restrooms.

0df15633-8f63-54c3-b679-1ab878e8c4f3.content: As a rule, direct general visitors who cannot use the Main Building restrooms during the construction period to restrooms outside the Main Building.

aa595f26-74ce-5f66-8a54-87bcc962cb06.content: During the construction period, direct users who cannot use the accessible restroom in the Main Building to the Student Centre.

8e868c0f-3a92-54e6-a76d-21d3ded46c65.content: The first-floor Innovation Hub does not operate its consultation desk during the construction period.

1dbffba3-b393-5a96-89c4-785df0782e3a.content: An Innovation Hub visitor accustomed to in-person consultation may expect to receive an immediate consultation at the first-floor desk during the construction period, see that the desk is closed, and then search again for the online consultation channel.

e79f6d6c-7637-5ef6-b373-651c21a6bb29.content: Air conditioning is occasionally interrupted for five to ten minutes for facility inspections.

faea18ec-3091-571f-be3f-345bdbf086b3.content: The construction period runs from June 24 through August 23.

ecf1c8bb-4099-5e7f-82e0-a95928defd5f.content: During the construction period, the facility guidance agent's response scope is limited to publicly disclosed operational impacts and it cannot verify or infer nonpublic types of work.

0c87297c-f5fb-5380-9cc3-efa21c0fb60b.content: Cleaning and security contract staff may find the designated service entrance during the construction period more burdensome than the familiar lobby shift change and may go to the wrong entrance at the start of a shift.
